verdict.rationale: Docs confirm post-call agent-analysis features — data collection (structured info like contact details), success evaluation (custom outcome/goal criteria), and sentiment analysis — which map well to entities, outcomes, and dispositions. However, the evidence pack shows these results are only described as being viewable/configurable, with no explicit documentation of a post-call webhook or API endpoint that delivers this structured analysis data automatically after each call (only tool-invocation webhooks and general API/dashboard management are documented). Missing for 10: explicit post-call webhook delivery mechanism, explicit API endpoint returning analysis JSON, and explicit 'disposition' field terminology.
